name: Northampton Green hide tanning
description: Excavated tanneries show the processing of hides into durable leather in a multi-phase urban working area.

date.label: Approximately 1470–1700
date.basis: Date describes the reported event or archaeological context, not the origin of the general technique.

events.statement: The excavation reports multiple tanning phases at The Green and 46 excavated pits across the site.

evidence.supports: The excavation reports multiple tanning phases at The Green and 46 excavated pits across the site.

earliest_record.rationale: First researched event for this local case; it does not establish worldwide priority.

caveats: The 46 pits cover multiple phases and are not evidence of simultaneous capacity; vegetable tanning is documented in the wider Northampton evidence rather than necessarily each pit at The Green.

research.note: Independent review checked the Heritage Gateway record’s approximate two-phase dating and site-wide total of 46 pits; these do not establish simultaneous operation.

measures.subject: The Green excavation
measures.conditions: Total excavated across multiple phases approximately 1470–1700; not simultaneous capacity or annual output.
